messages.content: {"id":"the-water-is-wide","first_keyMoment":"Measure 10, measure 14, measure 18, and measure 34 are the start of an eleven-measure repeat group (also including 42, 62, 66, 70, 86, 90, and 98) — eleven of the piece's 105 measures sharing identical content, direct evidence of one recurring accompaniment figure carrying nearly the whole piece. Chord-window analysis across the piece reads this harmonic world as G major-centered (72 of 98 labeled chord windows, 73%) — the basis for correcting the C major label this transcription originally carried."}
